text_en: Hear this word that the Lord has spoken against you, O people of Israel, against the whole family that I brought up out of the land of Egypt:
text_cn: 以色列子民！你们应听从上主关于你们，即关于我由埃及国领出来的全体民族所说的话：

text_en: You only have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
text_cn: “由世界上一切种族中，我只拣选了你们，为此，我必惩罚你们的罪恶。

text_en: Do two walk together unless they have made an appointment?
text_cn: 二人除非预约，岂能同行？

text_en: Does a lion roar in the forest, when it has no prey? Does a young lion cry out from its den, if it has caught nothing?
text_cn: 狮子若无猎物，岂能在林中咆哮？幼狮若非捕到食物，岂能在洞中吼叫？

text_en: Does a bird fall into a snare on the earth, when there is no trap for it? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when it has taken nothing?
text_cn: 雀鸟若无饵食，岂能落在地上？机槛若无所获，岂能由地上翻起？

text_en: Is a trumpet blown in a city, and the people are not afraid? Does disaster befall a city, unless the Lord has done it?
text_cn: 如在城中吹起号角，人民岂不恐怖？如城里发生灾祸，岂不是上主所为？

text_en: Surely the Lord God does nothing, without revealing his secret to his servants the prophets.
text_cn: 的确，吾主上主若不先将自己的计划启示给自己的先知，什么也不作。

text_en: The lion has roared; who will not fear? The Lord God has spoken; who can but prophesy?
text_cn: 狮子咆哮了，谁不害怕？吾主上主发了言，谁能不传他的话？”

text_en: Proclaim to the strongholds in Ashdod, and to the strongholds in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on Mount Samaria, and see what great tumults are within it, and what oppressions are in its midst. ”
text_cn: “你们要在亚述和埃及的宫殿高处宣布说：你们应聚集在撒玛黎雅的山上，观看那里的混乱和其中的残暴。

text_en: They do not know how to do right, says the Lord , those who store up violence and robbery in their strongholds.
text_cn: 他们不知行正直的事──上主的断语──只知在宫殿内积累强暴与欺压。

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : An adversary shall surround the land, and strip you of your defense; and your strongholds shall be plundered.
text_cn: 因此，吾主上主这样说：敌人要围困此地，推翻你的堡垒，抢掠你的宫殿。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : As the shepherd rescues from the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the people of Israel who live in Samaria be rescued, with the corner of a couch and part of a bed.
text_cn: 上主这样说：牧人怎样由狮子口中抢救出两条羊腿，或一块羊耳，以色列子民，即在撒玛黎雅斜倚在安乐椅角上，或大马士革榻上的人，也要怎样被救出。

text_en: Hear, and testify against the house of Jacob, says the Lord God , the God of hosts:
text_cn: 你们静听，并对雅各伯家作证──吾主上主万军的天主的断语──

text_en: On the day I punish Israel for its transgressions, I will punish the altars of Bethel, and the horns of the altar shall be cut off and fall to the ground.
text_cn: 在我惩罚以色列罪恶之日，我必毁坏贝特耳的祭坛， 祭坛的角必被打落在地上。

text_en: I will tear down the winter house as well as the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall come to an end, says the Lord .
text_cn: 我要破坏过冬和过夏的别墅，象牙宫也必遭毁坏， 高楼大厦也必荡然无存”──上主的断语。
